packages.qualification_task: Inventory remaining admission predicates and public entry points; measure accuracy, conservation, timing, allocation, memory and cancellation on committed builds.

Conformance tests for residual, charge, derivative, noise, trial/accepted ownership and atomic restore; measure adapter overhead. Frequency-grid and STB projection/workspace allocator causes are delivered by c13b01791 and 0ee0e3778. The scoped core-frequency-grid-errors-windows-20261006.json records typed source-chain, control/adapter metadata, buffer reuse, native and optimized WASM checks. This does not qualify every allocation owner or real allocator OOM behavior.

Preserve exact event clocks, accepted grids, retry/rollback and checkpoint continuation for every extraction. Checkpoint identity preparation now precedes the integration frame after admission (91bb08b05); core-control-noise-windows-20261006.json records the 1 MiB stack reproducer, preserved identity calculations and checkpoint regressions. Complete the remaining setup/trial/accept/observation/checkpoint boundaries.

Public phase execution, independent oracles, restart, fallible phase storage and fixed BJT/UIC initialization, typed allocation and per-site record-ceiling diagnostics, retained result accounting, and aggregate live/copy transport-record budgets are exercised. Accepted-work and continuation cancellation, native default/minimal test/release configurations, and repeated public-run/charged-transport measurements are exercised in core-gp-measurements-windows-20261005.json. Independent prescribed-terminal saturation/reverse-active/high-injection oracles and the rounding-sized event-remainder repair are exercised in core-gp-regimes-windows-20261005.json. The same 18 GP integration tests execute as WebAssembly in Node, a Chrome window and an optimized Chrome dedicated worker in core-gp-wasm-windows-20261006.json; native registration, strict WASM Clippy and a permanent Firefox worker CI selection are delivered. Complete remaining feedback/private-node and parameter cases, configuration coverage, whole-run memory/allocation, inner-solve cancellation and broader performance limits. Other state owners, VM transactions and full route coverage remain C01/C09/C12/C14 work. da18bfa88 adds independent bias-dependent forward/reverse charge oracles. 50523d8fb preserves small peripheral event-charge modes, with a six-node-order regression; the subsequent driven private high-injection convergence failure is repaired by the continuous-event integration references and event-approach fitting described below. Authenticated operating-point rate initialization and stationary-history event provenance repair the constant-bias private-node failure; static_private::gp_exact_phase_retains_a_small_reverse_charge_mode_at_private_dc_bias is active with unchanged accuracy limits. Audited integration-current references and balanced physical-event approach intervals repair the driven private-node regression, now active for all three dialects, both polarities and three bias regimes. The original 4 ps accuracy checks remain; BestAvailable additionally uses a 0.4 ps run to establish actual grid refinement against its already-adaptive 40 ps request, at the unchanged 0.7 error-reduction gate. Complete the remaining feedback/Weil, parameter, restart and resource/configuration qualification before C03c closes. C03d.1 now supplies physical voltage constraints, finite current, analytic time slopes and impulse ownership for structurally smooth prescribed behavioral forcing. The original sinusoidal behavioral-source reproducer has independent current/charge and checkpoint oracles in gp_phase_regimes/behavioral.rs. VCVS and VCCS now have physical event constraints/residuals, finite current and charge-impulse ownership; native VCCS current is observable through transient I(G...). Native CCCS now has weighted physical charge/current conservation, a constraint-consistent startup seed, and finite/impulsive F-current observations with independent startup, RC/refinement and restart tests. The direct current_controlled_startup_seed_satisfies_authored_voltage_constraints regression checks both source polarities, both VCVS gain signs and preservation of the incoming free coordinate; its reproduced sign reversal is repaired in the source/free-coordinate mappings, with checkpoint identity v105. Complete CCVS voltage-impulse descriptors, circuit-dependent/switched/stateful behavioral providers and remaining physical-event families/instances before C03d closes. d3d15ca70 delivers typed higher current impulse observations, analytic Fourier/rectangular-FFT contributions, result/live/compression/worker/Python persistence and accounting. core-current-derivatives-windows-20261006.json qualifies the bounded native, Python and optimized WASM routes. No physical provider produces the new derivatives yet. bcaefd8a3 implements analytic higher-current derivatives for every FFT window through the shared public retained-result route. core-window-derivatives-windows-20261006.json records independent 100-digit reference comparisons, boundary/range/resource/cancellation regressions, native integration and optimized WASM execution. Classical derivatives at genuine nonsmooth corners/support boundaries remain undefined and are diagnosed explicitly. ba2f8cfd4 implements direct current INTEG/AVG finite values and explicit primitive boundary availability, exact cross-owner support cancellation, live EQN/PARAM recovery and checked direct AT queries. core-measure-derivatives-windows-20261006.json records native and optimized WASM qualification. Generalized interval-operator composition, including nested INTEG/AVG and derived-expression distribution propagation, remains incomplete; support is propagated conservatively and unresolved interval consumers refuse rather than drop off-grid terms. Complete that algebra where defined, qualify genuine undefined-product/point-domain diagnostics, add voltage impulse observations and envelope projection, then circuit assembly/nonlinear coupling, atomic acceptance and public CCVS startup/event/restart evidence. Temporary refusals do not complete these implementations.

Complete the remaining 22 control dispositions, broader option/binding/configuration qualification, producer dependencies and bounded orchestration. Core table dispatch/presentation is delivered by b6d545304; cacddf36c aligns circuit/noise temperatures, 33c176b7a preserves only executed option overrides, and d7f95d93a retains frequency/control tables during textual expansion. Version-11 table documents and CLI/WASM publication are now implemented by 3a293bf4f, 69c94f135 and deeeab702; shared borrowed admission and CLI preflight are delivered by 87491ea53 and 6a76fd6a9. Hardening in 557cbdb0c, 58776c350 and af155b9c6 recognizes implicit TEMP coordinates, bounds and cancels document projection, rejects malformed finish fields and misaligned noise contributions, and preserves consumer limits. core-frequency-table-documents-windows-20261006.json records the scoped publication qualification; the older core-control-frequency-data-windows-20261006.json remains evidence for its earlier source revision and then-open adapter gaps. Preserve the parser contracts indexed in the plan and existing_evidence. Broader earlier-card/eager-parameter temperature cases, statistical/runtime binding, physical overrides, whole-run memory, cancellation/complexity and C14 compiler/runner causes remain open.
Polynomial two-tone products and intercepts; unequal tones, coincidence, windows, dynamic range, noise and compression.
Public periodic residual, small-signal, shooting and envelope evidence per model/instance restriction, including conservation and independent references.
Public memory, switch, line and magnetic cases with event refinement, causal histories, conservation and continuation.
DC reduction, modulated and correlated independent oracles, sideband convergence and integrated power.
Real runtime/generated/XSPICE models through core evaluators, complete state, operator-aware admission and rollback.
Coupled equilibrium, event ordering, rejected side effects and persisted deterministic continuation.
Analog/discrete period closure, moving-event derivatives, conversion, sampled noise and envelope evidence.
Every public route retains options, identity, units, errors, limits and producer state; compare transient observation routes.
Review responsibility boundaries and duplicate numerical contracts; measure memory, sparse scaling and hot-path changes.

Requirement-by-requirement committed-build audit across profiles/features; independent corpora, boundary fuzzing and failure atomicity. Investigate Windows compiler-build reproducibility: core-analysis-origins-windows-20261006.json preserves a Rust 1.95 expected-relocatable-expression failure while compiling rspice-core for a CLI test, followed by the same-command retry. This is separate from earlier Rust 1.94/faer compiler failures; passing runtime tests do not close these toolchain incidents. Investigate the native Windows wasm-bindgen-test-runner reliability incident in core-parent-temperature-windows-20261006.json: two multi-target runs crashed with 0xc0000005 before different test targets launched, at the same native executable fault offset. Affected targets and all selected core tests passed in partial/retry runs without source or runner changes; this does not qualify repeatable harness execution. core-provisional-parameter-temperature-windows-20261006.json records a further pinned Rust 1.94 rustc.exe access violation (0xc0000005) while rebuilding rspice-core at integration revision f8d45a153, before the parameter regression executable ran. The unchanged command passed after the other builds finished. The failure log is retained; no cause or toolchain reliability resolution is established.

guards.qualification_task: Public finite nonnegative delay execution replaces the blanket nonzero-PTF refusal; retain tested nonfinite, noncausal and unresolvable-arrival diagnostics.

C03d: implement actual residual, charge, derivative, sided forcing, impulse and state providers for admissible devices accompanying exact-delay GP. Smooth prescribed behavioral sources and native VCVS/VCCS now have physical equations and public numerical/continuation tests in the finite-voltage event formulation. Native CCCS now has weighted ideal-current/impulse incidence and finite controlling-branch equations. CCVS still needs its voltage-impulse descriptor; circuit-dependent, switched and stateful behavioral expressions remain unavailable. The family census admits 14 of 38 families with instance restrictions. Complete the other 24 families and remaining instance predicates; neither removing a guard nor skipping stamps completes support.
